title: Living crystal orb shown in psychologist's office
place_text: local psychologist's office, Western New York

tellings.quote: Okay, it has a defined shell. Uh, it's a literal crystal orb, but the inside of this orb, for lack of a better word, was alive.

plain: In 2008, in a local psychologist's office in Western New York, a boy was shown a crystal orb with a clear shell whose inside seemed alive. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, tells Michels he saw it himself. If true, it would mean someone was showing children strange living technology.
